stories.title: Labor looks to AI to tackle accommodation requests from disabled employees
stories.why: Employees say they’ve waited months or longer for decisions, as the Labor Department considers using AI to sort requests and flag missing documentation.

stories.title: DoD changes transitional health care eligibility for reservists following lawsuit
